title: Logo Colors
slide_intent: Give designers a reliable way to retain the signature’s contrast on light and dark surfaces.
strategic_value: Preserving the carrot colors while changing the wordmark can make the signature recognizable across backgrounds.
demonstration: The top row shows the dark wordmark on Cashew. The bottom row reverses it to a pale wordmark on dark Kale. Both keep the arrow green and the root orange.
practical_value: Choose the illustrated wordmark treatment according to the background. The accompanying note also allows white as a light ground.

content_islands.name: Light-ground example and rule
content_islands.spec: Use the upper pale field for the heading, usage note and positive lockup.

content_islands.name: Dark-ground example
content_islands.spec: Repeat the lockup on dark green under the horizontal division. Reverse the wordmark while preserving the two symbol colors.
